title_zh: 决定以持续志愿工作准备奖项提名

scenario.label_zh: 决定以持续志愿工作准备奖项提名
scenario.goal_zh: 区分单次善举与奖项要求，并决定收集持续服务记录而不猜测参选动机

context_zh: 社区志愿奖的两位提名人依据该奖项给定标准讨论候选材料，未作评奖决定。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Would the panel deem this nomination eligible if it describes only one good deed?

sentences.speaker: Avery
sentences.text: The award notice asks for sustained service. Helping once is kind, but the nomination needs more than that.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: I'm a little cynical about people who appear only when an award is announced.

sentences.speaker: Avery
sentences.text: We don't know anyone's motive. Do we have records of what this volunteer actually did?

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Yes, the food bank has attendance records from the past six months.

sentences.speaker: Avery
sentences.text: Then let's ask for a summary of that work and base the nomination on it, rather than on our guesses.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll gather the service record and check it against the award criteria before we submit anything.

targets.sense_zh: 愤世嫉俗的；怀疑动机的
